owner.title: Manager and Director of Tennis
bio: Fred Schwan is the Manager and Director of Tennis at DeLand Tennis Club. A USPTA and USPTR teaching professional with more than 35 years of experience, he brought the vintage clubhouse and clay courts at Country Club Corners back into action.
He teaches players of every age and ability, from a first swing to tournament play, and runs the club's clinics, leagues, junior programs and events.
Fred's goal is simple: bring the joy of tennis back to Volusia County, one player at a time.

highlights: Six clay courts, all lit for evening play
A vintage clubhouse, back in action
Programs for every age and level, beginner to tournament
